name: Grayscale Capital
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Capital Killer, an anti-capitalist hacker group, revealed on twitter that they have attacked the Grayscale official website, claiming it as a gift to the AVAV community in support of fairness and anti-capitalism. Currently, the Grayscale official website is inaccessible, but the page for Grayscale's Bitcoin ETF GBTC remains accessible.
